newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Avgold Dec qtr pre-capex net profit leaps.
newsitem.headline: Avgold Dec qtr pre-capex net profit leaps.

text.p: Avgold Ltd said on Tuesday that its gold mining companies posted a net profit after tax and before capital expenditure of 77.2 million rand in the quarter to December 31, against 46.8 million rand in the preceding quarter.
Total capital spending for the quarter was 28.5 million rand against 23.9 million rand.
Gold production was 8,149 kg versus 8,447 kg, while the average revenue received was 56,488 rand per kg of gold against 54,201 rand/kg in the September quarter.
The average yield was 4.85 grams per tonne against 4.98 in the previous quarter and the companies' mines milled a total of 1,681,798 tonnes compared to 1,697,404.
These are the first results since the formation of Avgold, which took effect from November 1, 1996, and comparative figures are presented on a proforma basis.
